summary: Added a normal live-root P4/P6 background entry for B02 period establishment and parent registration/material/circumstance/activity. It checks the existing foreground boundary before any write, records a pending fail-stop marker, executes the existing parent/world/B02 owner, and records the actual after snapshot and receipt through the existing independent-activity protocol. Ordinary P6 view and user say now succeed after cold reopen; direct/unrecorded mutations and pending states still refuse.

run_p6.experience ordinary lawful say after cold reopen

actual_writer_trace: run_p4.run_parent_operation [run_p4.py:235] acquires foreground_lock, opens state/actual-p2, check_source/check_boundary, saves pending, dispatches period/parent operation, then clear/record_activity.
run_p4.record_activity appends ledger.activity_turns and updates last_boundary with after snapshot + foreground_witness.
P6 ordinary view/say opens the same state/actual-p2, calls check_boundary against the new last boundary, and proceeds.
